evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Apply system-level thinking to design and own a company-wide data certification framework
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities are dominated by governance, certification frameworks, data trust signals, and quality checks with no velocity/speed language present.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: MoMo is a mobile payments/fintech company (default-high-risk sector) and the role owns a company-wide data trust/certification framework used across analytics and AI systems, so high.
evidence.collaboration_width: Data Governance; Data Platform teams; Data Engineering
evidence.data_team_maturity: mentor Data Analysts and Analytics Engineers to ensure consistent adoption
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Multiple named specialised teams (Data Governance, Data Platform, Data Engineering), a formal certification framework, and mentoring responsibilities indicate a mature, established data organisation.
evidence.jd_authorship: Experience with modern data stack technologies (dbt, Airflow/Dags, BigQuery/etc.)
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Precise concepts (data certification framework, semantic layers, data contracts, false trust/false failure signals) and named tools give a technically grounded, hiring-manager-authored description.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: design scalable systems for data certification, ownership, discoverability, reliability, and self-service analytics
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Primary framing is building the internal data platform/trust infrastructure for company-wide analytics and other data consumers, not a specific commercial/product/finance function.
evidence.autonomy_level: Apply system-level thinking to design and own a company-wide data certification framework... Define and drive analytics engineering standards across the organization
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Strategic verbs dominate throughout (design and own, define and drive, mentor) with the candidate setting organization-wide standards rather than executing scoped requests.
evidence.ai_role: help build the trusted data foundation that powers company-wide analytics and next-generation AI/agentic systems... Enable trusted, discoverable, and AI-ready data assets
evidence.ai_role_explanation: Candidate is expected to build certified, trusted data infrastructure that downstream AI/agentic systems consume, matching ai_enabler.
evidence.testing_framing: improving data reliability through automated quality checks, monitoring, and contributing to the evolution of the company's data foundation
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality and certification are framed as an owned, continuously-evolved responsibility with explicit ownership verbs (design and own, improve, define and drive).
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: improving its effectiveness, coverage, adoption, and data trust signals (accuracy, false trust/false failures, and usability for consumers)
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The entire role is framed around preventing untrustworthy data from reaching consumers and AI systems (false trust/false failures, certification), a dominant risk-control framing throughout.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Apply system-level thinking to design and own a company-wide data certification framework
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: JD centers on designing and owning a new company-wide certification framework and evolving it as a living system, so greenfield.
evidence.loss_aversion: improving its effectiveness, coverage, adoption, and data trust signals (accuracy, false trust/false failures, and usability for consumers) — data trustworthiness is the central, repeated framing of the role.
